Use case: compositing / premium product packaging.
Image 1 is the EXACT edit target: preserve this electric blue sealed foil card pack, its realistic folds, angular reflective detailing, crimped seals, front-facing proportions and studio lighting.
Image 2 is Docked's ACTUAL supplied wordmark. Faithfully use this wordmark shape and spelling, do not design a new logo.
Finish the actual customer-facing Standard AFL nine-card pack. Integrate the wordmark and all type INTO the metallic printed foil: metallic silver ink, slight embossed bevel, fine foil grain visible in the lettering, lighting and highlights that match the wrapper. The result must look physically manufactured and photographed, not flat text over a picture.
Place the wide DOCKED wordmark prominently about 39 percent down the pack, centered and about 72 percent of its width. Below it: letterspaced STANDARD. Below a restrained silver foil divider, centered AFL. Beneath that a large elegant 9 and smaller CARDS. Generous optical alignment, professional typography, clear at thumbnail size. Keep the shiny foil's dimensional texture and elegant angular corner details. Do not introduce boxes that look like web buttons.
Exact visible wording, each once: DOCKED / STANDARD / AFL / 9 / CARDS.
Output one isolated COMPLETE pack with transparent alpha outside the wrapper. No background gradient, no floor, no mockup board, no secondary pack, no text outside the pack. Preserve the full top and bottom seal without cropping. No league/team logos, photos, player, sponsors or extra slogans.
